name: The University of Hong Kong
summary: Pokfulam university incorporated in 1911 with 152 listed undergraduate programmes taught in English; 17 residential halls and colleges.

ib.text: Set per programme: an expected IB total from 34 (most arts, science, engineering) to 43 (MBBS), plus subject grades; English A 5 or English B 6. Many programmes interview shortlisted applicants.

dates.label: First round: application in by noon Hong Kong time
First round: predicted grades typed in and documents uploaded
Applications close at noon Hong Kong time

programmes.name: Bachelor of Dental Surgery
programmes.about: Six years to become a dentist, mostly in clinics and the dental teaching hospital in Hong Kong, with hands-on training in medical and surgical settings across the city. The degree is registrable with the Dental Council of Hong Kong.
programmes.ib: Two of HL Biology, HL Chemistry and HL Maths (AA or AI) at grade 6; personal statement and interview. The faculty limits non-local places.

needs.note: Two of these HL subjects at 6; Maths AA and AI count once
English B needs grade 6, at SL or HL

programmes.selectionNote: 41 is the expected lower boundary. Interviews for international applicants run in late January 2027; non-local places are restricted, so apply early.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Dental Surgery: taught in the city's dental teaching hospital (programme page)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery
programmes.about: Six years of medicine built on small-group problem-based tutorials, early clinical exposure and community placements in clinics, hospices and maternal and child health services, ending in an assistant internship.
programmes.ib: HL Biology or HL Chemistry at grade 4 and a good working knowledge of Chinese; interview. English A 5 or English B 6.

needs.note: English B needs grade 6, at SL or HL

programmes.selectionNote: 43 is the expected lower boundary. Interviews for shortlisted international applicants are tentatively set from December 2026 to August 2027; first-choice candidates are favoured.

flagshipSource.title: MBBS: problem-based small-group tutorials and early clinical exposure (programme page)

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Surveying
programmes.about: Four years across land development: land administration, property development, construction management, real estate finance, facility management and conservation, with studio work and the chance of an internship or a semester of exchange.
programmes.ib: No set subjects; English A 5 or English B 6 and an interview.

needs.note: English B needs grade 6, at SL or HL

programmes.selectionNote: 34 is the expected lower boundary. Interviews for international applicants are in December 2026 and mid-April 2027; IB Diploma holders get 24 credits of advanced standing.

flagshipSource.title: BSc(Surveying): integrated across six surveying divisions, accredited by HKIS and RICS (programme page)

faculties.name: Faculty of Architecture
faculties.line: 34 IB points and no set subjects; Architectural Studies and Landscape Studies add a portfolio or creative work by early December.

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: 34 IB points and no set subjects for the BA (40 for the Elite Programme); shortlisted applicants are interviewed.

faculties.name: HKU Business School
faculties.line: 36 to 41 IB points; Maths and English grades are required, and Quantitative Finance asks Maths HL 7.

faculties.name: Faculty of Dentistry
faculties.line: 41 IB points with two HL subjects at 6 from Biology, Chemistry and Maths; the faculty limits non-local places.

faculties.name: Faculty of Education
faculties.line: 34 to 37 IB points; the BEd-with-Science route needs Maths and a science at grade 4, speech therapy needs fluent Chinese.

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering
faculties.line: 34 to 40 IB points; Maths at HL 5 (or AA SL 6) and an HL science at 5 (or SL at 6) for most degrees.

faculties.name: Faculty of Law
faculties.line: 40 to 41 IB points; LLB wants 6 in every subject and 19 points from three HL subjects, with an interview.

faculties.name: Li Ka Shing Faculty of Medicine
faculties.line: MBBS 43 points with Biology or Chemistry HL 4 and working Chinese; nursing and pharmacy ask for working Cantonese.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: 34 IB points with Maths and one science each at grade 4; the Science Master Class asks 42 and grade 6 in Maths and an HL science.

faculties.name: Faculty of Social Sciences
faculties.line: 34 to 38 IB points and no set subjects for most degrees; Social Work adds an interview and a written test.

faculties.name: School of Computing and Data Science
faculties.line: 37 to 39 IB points; Maths HL 6 (or SL 7) and a science, economics or computer science subject for most degrees.

faculties.name: School of Innovation
faculties.line: 34 IB points; Maths and a science or Design Technology subject at grade 4 (HL) or 5 (SL); shortlisted applicants are interviewed.

faculties.name: School of Future Media
faculties.line: 34 IB points and no set subjects; Journalism, Media and AI asks for a personal statement, predicted scores and an interview.

faculties.name: School of Biomedical Engineering
faculties.line: 36 IB points; Maths at HL 5 (or AA SL 6) and Biology, Chemistry or Physics at 5 (HL) or 6 (SL), with an interview.

notes: Hong Kong has no EU rate: non-local tuition for 2027/28 is HK$250,000 for non-STEM faculties, HK$280,000 for STEM and HK$590,000 for MBBS and dentistry.
Type your predicted and final IB grades into HKU's own application system; an upload alone is not enough, so ask your IB coordinator in good time.
IB Diploma holders with seven years of secondary education can get advanced standing credits, set per programme (24 for Surveying, up to 30 for Computing and Data Science).
